'''The Clean Page''' is [[House Blackcrest]]'s ceremony of the single version. Before an important chronicle entry, ''everything'' is first written: every version, every contradiction. Then it is burned, and one clean version is entered into the [[Chronicle of Victory|Permanent Book]]. The ash is kept in urns at [[Crown-watch]].

House doctrine, spoken to every novice chronicler: ''"The Clean Page is not made of lies — it is made of true things, chosen."''
